name: Sisley Choi Si-pui
bio: Sisley Choi Si-pui is a Hong Kong actress. She was the first runner-up at Miss Hong Kong 2013. Choi went to high school in New Zealand and studied ethnology in Germany. She started her acting career soon after competing in the pageant, and made her debut in the 2014 drama, Overachievers.
